title: Qt: Normalize SCTP dialogs
description:
Use normal sized buttons and standard buttons when available,
Remove unused clutter,
Add hint about SCTP preference,
Clean up SCTP menu items.

Fixes #16367

notes.body: Looks a lot better. I still get some problems on Linux having to do with the sizes. In the "Show All Associations" dialog the "Number of DATA Chunks" column size is always set to 150 which is too narrow for the column header.

added 3 commits
  • 5e18926c...0bed6790 - 2 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • 0779272b - Qt: Normalize SCTP dialogs
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/12482/diffs?diff_id=809724113&start_sha=5e18926c6c1dbe22286b9b705cc557295b979ac8)
enabled an automatic merge when the pipeline for 0779272be5ddfd436da08eb551fb300f9ecfa3da succeeds
